overview: Comparison of Indian Income Tax regimes (Section 115BAC New Tax Regime vs Old Tax Regime) for financial planning and advisory algorithms.

section_87a_rebate.new_regime: Zero tax on taxable income up to ₹7,00,000 (effective zero tax up to ₹7,75,000 with standard deduction)
section_87a_rebate.old_regime: Zero tax on taxable income up to ₹5,00,000

section_80c_limit.old_regime: Max ₹1,50,000 (EPF, PPF, ELSS, Life Insurance, Home Loan Principal)

section_80ccd_1b_nps.new_regime: Employer contribution u/s 80CCD(2) up to 14% allowed

decision_rule_for_advisor_agent: If total itemized deductions (80C + 80D + HRA + 24b) exceed ₹3,75,000 for an individual earning above ₹15,00,000, the Old Regime is typically mathematically superior; otherwise, the New Regime provides lower tax liability with zero compliance friction.
